items.rationale: Launch of 'Amuchart', billed as the first platform dedicated to AI music, with a plan to have strong AI songs re-recorded by human singers. This is a new distribution path for AI-made tracks in Korea.
items.excerpt: Former NOISE member Hong Jong-gu launches 'Amuchart', billed as the first platform dedicated to AI music, and plans to have well-received AI songs re-recorded by real singers as a management business.

items.rationale: An AI that predicts the ROI of a music marketing campaign before the money is spent, selected for Google's Gemini forum from more than 2,000 applicants. It is a practical tool for labels and marketers.
items.excerpt: French startup Base for Music, which uses AI to predict the ROI of music marketing campaigns, was selected for Google's Gemini Startup Forum from 2,000+ applicants.

items.rationale: The RIAA's chief compares AI to Napster and explains why he expects the NO FAKES voice and likeness act to pass. This is the industry's lead lobbyist on the deepfake rules artists will be working under.
items.excerpt: On Billboard's On the Record, RIAA CEO Mitch Glazier compares Napster with AI and explains why he is confident the NO FAKES Act on voice/likeness deepfakes will pass.

items.rationale: Argues that the real dividing line is disclosing how much a human made, not banning AI. This framing matters for artists deciding how to label AI-assisted releases.
items.excerpt: Op-ed arguing AI can support music creation, but transparency about the degree of human involvement is essential to preserving the artist-fan connection.

items.rationale: Closing installment of Ilgan Sports' K-pop and AI series: K-pop creators are shifting from making every part by hand to directing generative AI like conductors, keeping for themselves the parts AI cannot replace. This shows how Korean producers are reorganizing their work around AI.
items.excerpt: Closing installment of Ilgan Sports' K-pop and AI series: as generative AI shakes up K-pop production, creators are becoming 'conductors' directing AI while focusing on what cannot be replaced.
